name: Songs @ the Creek | Bluff Creek Baptist Church
description: Psalms, hymns, and songs of hope for the road between Sundays. Worship centered on Christ and grounded in Scripture.
selection_rule: No Bethel, Hillsong or Elevation compositions/recordings or named publishing ties. Brandon Lake omitted from this starter at the pastor’s direction.
scope_note: Specific song/recording credits checked in public sources. No exhaustive audit of unrelated collaborations or downstream royalty recipients is claimed; shared administration alone is not a church tie.

tracks.recording_note: The matching release distinguishes the unqualified song title from separate Accompaniment Track and Instrumental entries. The saved track is the unqualified 4:56 entry, supporting a vocal companion recording; a brief audible check remains. Research album labeling was corrected from Hymns, Vol. 1 to the actual accompaniment release. Official composition credits are retained; a secondary retailer additionally credits Keith and Kristyn Getty, an unresolved recording-credit discrepancy that introduces no excluded entity.
